name: jpchauny-plugins
description: Shared Claude Code plugins for working in three layers: specifications (people), norms (generated), code (agents)

plugins.name: shared
plugins.description: How the team works: explore before specifying or building; pending items and findings go to GitHub issues, each with a self-contained hand-off; explanations one step at a time, waiting for the user's got-it; a recap of the current session after time away

plugins.name: specs
plugins.description: Layer 1 tools for the people who write a project's specifications in plain prose: readability, renumbering chapters, reviewing a change

plugins.name: norms
plugins.description: Layer 2: the norms generator common to every project, which annotates layer 1 specs with stable norm IDs (/norms:build, /norms:verify)

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Layer 3: the implementation method; code and tests built only from a pinned version of layer 2, citing its norm IDs, and every inconsistency sent back to layer 1

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Above the three layers, across the three repositories of a project: coordinates the work from specs to norms to code, and starts a new project (creates its three repositories, enables in each the plugins of its layer, writes the initial documents)
